d:
Bachon ka tiffin roz vapas aata hai? Try kijiye ye No-Fry Sooji Aloo Veg Tikki — bina bread, bina fry ke!
Poha, boiled aloo aur bharpoor sabziyon se bani crispy tikki jise bachon khushi khushi khayenge.
Bonus: 2 tarike — Suji Sandwich Style aur Suji Appe/Kachori Style, dono bina tale!
Bina bread crumbs, bina besan ke crispy veg tikki banana seekhein
Ghar ki sooji se bread jaisa "wrapper" banane ka simple trick
Bonus: same filling se Appe/Kachori style version bhi
Bachon ke tiffin, evening snacks aur guests ke liye ready-to-serve idea
Comment karein — Aap Sandwich banayenge ya Appe? Bataiye
